information.description:
Brutalizers are all about exactly what their name entails: brutally beating down on anyone beneath them. The shotgun is just there to get a hit in before they close the distance and pummel you in.

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

The minds at Serbia-based Rostović set out to prove that "smart" doesn't have to mean "expensive." The fruit of their endeavor is the Palica, based on their time-tested Igla model. Was the experiment a success? Opinions are divided. The Palica's price is certainly lower than the competition, but so it also has the craftsmanship to match. This shotgun possesses the basic functionality of a Smart-class shotgun, but it's not worth the breath required to compare it to Arasaka or Tsunami weapons. Still, for those whose wallets are already squeezed, the Palica really is the "smart" choice.

Cost: 250eb (Expensive)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2
Increase Body by 2 (and related stats). Stacks. Max at 10 Body.
